description_en: Add or remove local administrator permissions on a cloud computer for a convenience account
description_zh: 为便捷账号添加或者去除云电脑的本地管理员权限
kebab_example: aliyun eds-user batch-set-desktop-manager --users alice --is-desktop-manager 1 --business-channel ENTERPRISE --api-version 2021-03-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchSetDesktopManager

parameters.description_en:
Whether the convenience account has the local administrator permissions on cloud computers.

Valid values:

*   0: no
*   1 (default): yes
parameters.description_zh: 该便捷账号是否具备云电脑的本地管理员权限。
